title: ClimbX launch — 'your growth co-pilot for X'
summary: A 30 s indie-SaaS launch video with no voice. It opens on the pain (an orange field of empty 'What's happening?' compose cards, 'what do I post today?'), resolves into the logo, then walks feature by feature on a light grey canvas: '10 ready posts every day, in your voice.' with cards flying in, 'make it yours.' with a rebuilt post editor and a post-rating card, 'your week, handled.' with a calendar of post cards, a dark ember section 'build connections, not impressions.' with a reply composer, and a logo end card with social-proof stat tiles (0 → 10K followers, 9.9M impressions, 140 days) and a 'start your 7-day trial' pill. Clean, warm, confident.
fit_reason: This is the template for a SaaSSuite feature launch: pain hook → logo → one benefit headline per feature with rebuilt UI cards → proof stats → CTA, with a black-and-one-accent headline system.

palette.mood: light airy grey canvas with one hot orange accent; full-orange pain scene and a dark ember-glow section for contrast

typography.display: tight heavy grotesk lowercase (Inter Display Black / Satoshi Black look) with negative tracking
typography.size_behaviour: headline top-left ~8% height above the UI, or centred big for statements; giant numeral for counters (10)
typography.notes: Two-tone headline: first phrase black, payoff phrase orange with a full stop. Tiny orange letter-spaced mono kicker above headlines (INSPIRATION, STUDIO, CALENDAR) and HUD micro labels in corners (THE BLANK PAGE, 02 / STUDIO, CLIMBX.SO, timecode). Small mono orange line on end card: '@DANIELSMIDSTRUP, BUILDING CLIMBX IN PUBLIC'.

text_animation: letters slide/drop in from below with blur and slight overshoot ('what do' → 'what do I post today?')
headline types in word by word, payoff word in orange lands last
logo assembles: icon + letters scatter in with particles then settle
motion: dozens of compose cards float in 3D depth on orange (pain)
post cards fly in from the right with motion trails and stack
rebuilt editor: text types itself, a green 'Ready to post' pill pops with confetti dots, rating bars fill
calendar columns fill with post cards, then a zoom-out reveals a whole month of cards
dark section with ember glow and drifting sparks; reply typed into a composer
transitions: fade through dark to the ember section
graphic_elements: rebuilt X-style compose and post cards
pill CTA with orange arrow button
ui_treatment: rebuilt simplified UI cards (editor, calendar, reply box) floating on light grey with soft shadows, shown at readable scale; no device frames

sound.music: upbeat electronic/indie bed, loud master (-10.3 LUFS)
sound.sync: beats on headline landings and card arrivals

signature_moves: two-tone lowercase headline: black setup + orange payoff with a full stop
pain scene of empty compose cards on full orange
rebuilt UI card + 'Ready to post' pill with confetti
end card with stat tiles counting up and a pill CTA

best_segments.what: Orange field of floating empty compose cards, 'what do I post today?' slides in, cut to dark dot → flag → ClimbX logo with particle burst.
'make it yours.' editor card: text types, rating card slides in with green bars, 'Ready to post' pill pops.
'your week, handled.' calendar fills with post cards then zooms out to a month grid.
Logo end card with two-tone tagline, stat tiles counting up, URL + 'start your 7-day trial' pill.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion. Rebuild UI as styled divs (cards with 12 px radius, soft shadow), animate with stagger from x:+400 and blur. Headline: two spans, the orange one delayed 0.15 s. Counters with GSAP snap. Orange pain scene: 30 cards in a CSS 3D scene with perspective and random z. Ember section: radial gradient + particle canvas.
recreate.prompt: Light, warm SaaS launch on soft grey #f2f2f2 with near-black #0b0b0b type and one hot orange accent #f86028. Open on a full-orange field of empty 'What's happening?' cards and 'what do I post today?', resolve to the logo. Then one lowercase two-tone headline per feature ('make it yours.' with the payoff in orange) above rebuilt UI cards that fly in and fill themselves, a dark ember-glow section, and an end card with counting stat tiles and a pill CTA.
